title: Hold: one page
notices: A one page plan, "here is the plan", for a brief that needs three parts.

recorded.text: Before you submit. This is one page.
Jay asked for a plan he can take to leadership.
Give him three: the problem with the numbers,
the cause, and the fix with your test.

new.text: Before you submit. Jay takes this to leadership.
Could they find the problem, the cause, and the fix on one page?

stake.label: +300 if it has all three parts

lines.text: Because Jay takes this to leadership.
They need the problem, the cause, and the fix with proof.
One page can't carry all three.

lines: The wait, and what it costs
The router, and how I will test it

then: He goes, and the plan grows to three pages in the app. He does not check it after.
